title: Program Payment Access Readability Cleanup

reasons: Fresh screenshots show the Program tab rail clipped on desktop and mobile.
The Payment / Access table card is forced into a side column with dark-on-dark table text.
The Command Bot Actions empty panel is large and bright, dominating the payment/access route.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time Operations Program Payment / Access route
likely_external_provider_blockers: Payment, payout, Stripe, access-sync, checkout, connector setup, and live access grants are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this payment/access readability cleanup, continue manual screenshot-reviewed packets for CRM contact detail polish, IA/nav/filter cleanup, or remaining portal defects.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time Program Payment / Access route feel even and clean by fixing clipped tabs, unreadable access table text, and oversized empty command-bot presentation.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No payment, payout, Stripe, checkout, access-sync, access grant, member entitlement, connector setup, CRM/contact, bot preview, typed action, API, route access, or helper behavior change.
No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account, campaign, external CRM write, external send/publish/upload/payment, raw private evidence, or secret exposure.
No GHL runtime or LeadConnector reference.
affected_surfaces: One Time Operations Program Payment / Access route

inspection_targets: public/css/one-time-operations.css One Time Operations route overrides
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The Program subtab rail clips tabs at the right edge on desktop and mobile.
The Payment / Access table header and row text are dark-on-dark and hard to read.
The payment/access card is forced into a narrow side column by the inherited dashboard grid.
The Command Bot Actions empty panel is bright, oversized, and visually louder than the payment/access readiness content.

expanded_phrases.clean: The payment/access route should read like a compact Operations readiness view, not a mix of clipped navigation, hidden table text, and a dominant empty bot panel.
expanded_phrases.even: Top tabs, heading, access table, guardrail copy, and command-bot empty state should align within a consistent One Time admin surface.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: Once data loads, the route should immediately show a readable Payment / Access title, contained tabs, readable access row text, and an empty command-bot state that does not overpower the page.
expanded_phrases.payment/access: For this packet, payment/access means read-only local Operations readiness display only. It does not enable checkout, charge, payout, access sync, Stripe, connector setup, member entitlement changes, or live access grants.
expanded_phrases.CRM: For this packet, CRM appears only as an out-of-scope first-party BNA Operations data boundary. No CRM/contact data model, import, external CRM runtime, send, or mutation work is included.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The payment/access route remains a first-party BNA Operations provider-readiness view scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix One Time Program Payment / Access readability so the Program subtab rail is contained, the access table text is readable, and the command-bot empty state no longer dominates the route.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile payment/access screenshots show wrapped/contained tabs, readable table headers and row text, and a compact dark command-bot empty state with no horizontal overflow.
acceptance_criteria: The provider program route has a scoped One Time route marker for CSS targeting.
The One Time Program top filter rail wraps or contains all tabs on desktop and mobile without clipping text.
Payment / Access table headers, row values, section counters, and disabled/no-sync guardrail copy are readable in the One Time dark theme.
The Command Bot Actions empty state is visually quiet and proportionate to the access content.
Payment/access behavior, CRM/contact data, command bot actions, APIs, action registry, route access, and external-provider guardrails are unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Current screenshot evidence shows the payment/access clipping and readability defects.
The likely fix is scoped to route marker markup and One Time Operations CSS overrides.
No payment, access, external provider, credential, connector, account, or legal/financial decision is required for local visual implementation.
